verdict.rationale: Smithery's evidence covers an MCP registry, connection and credential management, and a CLI. Nothing shows a user-facing way to set up automations that run on their own in the background, whether scheduled or recurring. Triggers only let MCP servers surface upstream events for consumers to build on, which is a developer building block rather than an automation feature. The hosted connection services were also shut down on 2026-10-31.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
